content: Welcome to the Incident Response (DFIR) Agent Dashboard. Here you monitor ongoing incidents and active threats.
This queue displays newly ingested alerts from the SIEM, awaiting automated or manual forensic analysis.
The tools panel gives the agent access to Memory Dumps, Packet Captures (PCAPs), and automated Containment strategies.
Access the Theory Wiki to learn about specific IoCs, Malware Families, and Containment tactics at any time.
